turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it ridiculous to throw my dog a birthday party?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all, lots of people do. How old is your dog turning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I want to make a monthly budget but every app I try feels complicated.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You could keep it simple with a spreadsheet, or try the envelope method with cash. Which feels more doable for you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Alex real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I forgot to tell you, your mum called.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, did she say what she wanted?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you take the dog out tonight? I have to work late.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, what time does he usually go?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Around seven, and then once more before bed.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Does he pull on the leash? Last time he dragged me toward every squirrel.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Use the harness, it's on the hook by the door. Much better.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry for the interruption, I'm done. What was the rest of it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. We were picking a budgeting method, spreadsheet or envelopes.
